name: 1social-facebook
description: A Facebook Page posting workflow for the 1Social connector: write a post that fits the Page, attach images or video, check it against Facebook's limits, then publish now or schedule it.

interface.longDescription:
Write and publish posts to your Facebook Page without leaving the chat. Describe what you want to say, or paste a draft, and get a post shaped for Facebook: a clear first line, a readable length and a link that shows a preview card. Attach images or a video, check the post against Facebook's limits before anything goes out, then publish it now or schedule it up to 30 days ahead in your own timezone.

After publishing you get a receipt that says whether the post actually landed, with a link to it. Anything still scheduled can be edited or cancelled from the chat.

Requires the 1Social connector ("Instagram & TikTok by 1Social"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a6eeddc84a08191af3e632007e03ba3 and sign in. You also need a Facebook Page connected to your 1Social account.
defaultPrompt: Write a Facebook post for my Page announcing our new product and publish it.
Schedule this Facebook post with the attached photo for Friday at 10am.
Turn this blog post into a short Facebook post with the link.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: guided Facebook Page posting and scheduling over the 1Social connector.
